comparison.objective: Insert an emergency-stop body through a keyed panel hole and thread on its locking ring; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed cylindrical insertion and rear-side ring threading versus long asymmetric rail support, simultaneous tab depression and paired-prong insertion, telescoping rear alignment, and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush with tab in notch and locking ring advanced snugly versus four spring-prong engagements at matching rack units and bottom-hole screws.
comparison.reason: Both combine insertion and fastening, but the candidate's separated staged latches, long-part load management, and rack-level preservation test a meaningfully different capability.
